assets.name: jacket-body.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art paper-doll walking sprite sheet for a cozy modern dog RPG. Follow the two provided visual style references: richly shaded crisp chibi pixel art, dark 1-pixel-looking outlines, small hands and stout boots, compatible with the teal-jacket traveler walking sprites.
Primary request: create a square transparent PNG in a rigorously regular 4 columns by 4 rows grid: exactly 16 sprites, one centered inside each equal-sized invisible cell. Rows top to bottom are DOWN facing viewer, LEFT profile, RIGHT profile, UP facing away. Columns left to right are four DISTINCT phases of a walking loop: left foot forward/right arm forward; passing pose with feet nearer center; right foot forward/left arm forward; opposite passing pose. Do not merely repeat a stance. Both arms and both legs remain anatomically coherent, alternating clearly.
Every sprite is ONLY A HEADLESS CHIBI BODY with a small bare neck stub at its central top anchor. There is absolutely NO head, NO hair, NO face, NO helmet. Friendly nonviolent paper-doll clothing cutout, no gore. Copy the existing traveler's short stout body proportions. Standardize every sprite within a 256x256 cell on an imagined 1024x1024 canvas: neck top anchored around cell x128,y72; feet baseline around y213; centered torso around x128; total body height about 140 pixels, width at most 122 pixels, with generous clear margins. Legs bend and arms swing yet neck anchors remain stable and soles stay close to the same baseline. Body scale consistent across every cell and direction. Entire body contained in cell, no clipping, no contact with neighbors.
Scene/backdrop: REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, completely empty, no checkerboard pattern, no floor, no ground shadows, no scenery. No grid lines, no labels, no text, no borders, no watermark.
Outfit: teal zip travel jacket, slightly open at center showing a white undershirt; charcoal pants; warm brown hiking boots; small vivid orange backpack matching the existing traveler. Jacket is teal in every view and frame so it can later be recolored. Include backpack shoulder straps in front and orange bag on back. Headless neck collar opening must be clearly centered. Deliver exactly this one 4x4 headless body sheet.

assets.name: traveler-heads.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art paper-doll HEAD atlas for a cozy modern dog RPG.
Primary request: create one square transparent PNG with a rigorously regular 4 columns by 4 rows grid. Exactly 16 standalone head sprites, one per equal invisible cell. Columns left to right are DOWN/front facing viewer, LEFT profile, RIGHT profile, UP/back of head. Rows top to bottom are four different traveler identities, each repeated in all four directions:
Row 1: original traveler's tousled short dark brown hair, determined friendly youthful face, warm brown eyes, fair warm skin.
Row 2: chestnut low ponytail, bright friendly youthful face, warm brown eyes, fair warm skin; ponytail kept short and compact.
Row 3: short wavy auburn hair, cheerful round youthful face, warm brown eyes, fair warm skin.
Row 4: silver bob hairstyle, gentle youthful face, warm brown eyes, fair warm skin; bob ends around jaw level.
These are HEADS ONLY with a tiny bare neck stub centered at bottom, absolutely NO shoulders, NO torso, NO clothing, NO accessories, NO busts, NO extra faces or extra heads. Back views only show back of hair and a small neck stub, with no facial features.
Style: match provided references: rich crisp chibi pixel art, dark pixel outlines, warm detailed faces, nuanced clustered hair highlights; same chibi head/face proportions as the original teal-jacket traveler. Keep every head exactly the same overall face and skull size across identities and directions. Imagined canvas 1024x1024, each cell 256x256; every head centered horizontally at cell x128, tiny neck bottom anchored at y197, full head including hair around 128-145 pixels tall and 115-135 pixels wide, all head and hair fully contained with generous clear margins. Compact hairstyles so they combine cleanly with bodies. Uniform baseline and central neck attachment point for every sprite.
Scene/backdrop: genuine REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, empty; no checkerboard drawing, no ground, no shadows, no scenery. No grid lines, no cell borders, no text, no labels, no watermark. Deliver exactly this one 4x4 head-only atlas.
